shortDescription: West African crude oil differentials remained supported on Friday from disruption in the Middle East that was expected to boost demand for alternative grades.

children: West African crude oil differentials remained supported on Friday from disruption in the Middle East that was expected to boost demand for alternative grades.
Earlier in the week, Nigerian grade Qua Iboe was heard on offer at dated Brent plus $6 and Bonga at dated plus $9, but no deals were heard at these levels.
No updated offers were heard on Friday.
Freight rates including from West Africa have soared to record highs after the last escalation in the Middle East war, potentially impacting demand.
